hypothesis.statement: A nonzero subset of Forge PATCH_REJECTED outcomes can be caused by validating a worker patch against a different repository head than the one recorded at prompt time; blind or malformed patch synthesis remains a serious competing cause.
hypothesis.counterhypothesis: Nearly all patch rejections are intrinsically malformed or semantically guessed patches, so source-head binding will improve provenance but not materially improve conversion.
hypothesis.discriminator: Combine exact-source worker grounding with exact worker-head Forge checkout, then compare future PATCH_REJECTED/validated/accepted state distribution. A source-valid patch that applies only at its recorded producer head is a direct positive mechanism witness; unchanged rejection rates after source binding would favor the counterhypothesis.
